non finalem, sed efficientem petebat.
ARTICULUS II.
ARistoteles lib. 3. de partibus animalium cap 9.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. Doubtful readings: "coletur" (possibly "colatur") and "sævum" (the word after "sanguineæ" could read "favum"); both are marked in the text only where I could not confirm the letters. The initial "A" of "ARistoteles" is a large initial and is joined to the word as the rules require. Printed spacing before the comma in "Pingue , inquit," and before "facilè" is kept as printed.
